visualCharacteristics.purpose: www's site search result page: search field, 'Your search for <phrase>', result count, ranked results with excerpt, pagination
traits: underlined search field with a magnifier button
light heading with the phrase in bold
results separated by thin lines: bold headline, excerpt with the matched words in bold
ten results per page, numbered pages below

contentPattern.structure: as the library's search block: one optional row with the query index path (default /{cc}/{ll}/search-index.json); optional label | text rows

usage: /{cc}/{ll}/support/search/search-result, the page the header and footer search lead to.
reuseGuidance: Use for full-text search over a locale's pages; the pages need the search index (helix-query.yaml search-<cc>-<ll>).
